findings.summary: The manifest declares domain_engine.runtime.entrypoint as src/main.mjs, but no such file exists — only apps/domain/src/domain.mjs is present, and nothing in the run wires it up as a runnable entrypoint.

Both manifest interfaces declare design_systems: [design-system], but no design-system exists anywhere in the run. apps/ui/src/app.mjs is a bare Express JSON API with no browser rendering, no React, and no client bootstrap file (no src/main.tsx/jsx, no createRoot/hydrateRoot) — the 'browser' interface kind is not actually realized.

The domain engine's in-memory stores (this.workshops, this.participants, this.offeredPlaces) are declared empty in the constructor and are never populated by any bootstrap/fixture logic, despite the manifest declaring bootstrap: fixtures. As written, every domain operation would immediately fail with 'Workshop not found' / 'Participant not found' — the engine has no reachable happy path.

apps/domain/src/domain.mjs re-encodes the UJG's org.openuji.domain-model extension (entities, relationships, domainOperations, invariants, with matching labels/descriptions/pre/postconditions) as a hardcoded parallel JS catalog, duplicating the UJG instead of treating it as the sole semantic authority.

The email touchpoint (urn:ujg:touchpoint:email, delivery.adapter: fake-client) and the sqlite persistence / fake-auth-adapter adapters declared in the manifest have no realization anywhere in the run, and no test file of any kind exists to verify any modeled branch, effect, or invariant.
